tested_topology_constraint: fungal sus-like + T-DNA sus forced monophyletic
biological_alternative: The fungal sus-like genes are related to the T-DNA sus of agrobacterial plasmids (bacterial origin by transfer from a plasmid-bearing donor).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 56 fungal OCD-fold leaves (52 sus-like genes + 4 fungal OCD-fold genes outside the sus-like clade) + 24 plasmid sus references (seed and other plasmid references). All other leaves free.
interpretation: Not rejected: a single clade of the fungal sus-like genes and the plasmid T-DNA sus is as good as the ML tree. Compatible with a bacterial T-DNA origin of the fungal sus-like genes; it does not exclude other topologies and does not by itself show the direction of transfer.
caveat: Positive (compatibility) test; non-rejection is not proof. The reference/partner set forced into the clade (28 leaves) is not itself a clade in the unconstrained ML tree (checked with the fungal genes under test pruned), so part of the likelihood loss may come from forcing it together.

tested_topology_constraint: fungal sus-like + alternative bacterial OCD-fold proteins forced monophyletic
biological_alternative: The fungal sus-like genes belong with the other (non-T-DNA) bacterial OCD-fold proteins rather than with the T-DNA sus.
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 56 fungal OCD-fold leaves + 14 other-bacterial OCD-fold proteins + 19 rhizobial chromosomal OCD-fold proteins + 10 outgroup proteins (5 fungal OCD-fold) + 2 native Sordariomycetes OCD-fold proteins. The 24 T-DNA sus references are left outside the clade.
interpretation: Rejected: the fungal sus-like genes do not group with the non-T-DNA OCD-fold proteins as one clade separate from the T-DNA sus; the T-DNA sus is the closer relative.
caveat: Partner set contains fungal outgroup and native fungal proteins as well as bacterial ones; the test excludes this particular mixed grouping, not every possible non-T-DNA relationship.

tested_topology_constraint: fungal sus-like (52) + the native fungal OCD-fold homologs of the tree (2 native Sordariomycetes proteins and 4 fungal OCD-fold genes outside the sus-like clade) forced monophyletic
biological_alternative: The fungal sus-like genes are descendants of native fungal OCD-fold genes (single native origin).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 56 fungal OCD-fold leaves (52 sus-like + 4 outside the sus-like clade) + 2 native Sordariomycetes OCD-fold proteins (Pseudopestalotiopsis) = 58 leaves.
interpretation: Rejected: the fungal sus-like genes and the available native fungal OCD-fold homologs do not form one clade; evidence against a single native fungal origin of the sus-like genes.
caveat: The native fungal set forced into the clade is not itself monophyletic in the unconstrained ML tree (also not after the fungal genes under test are pruned from it); a rejection therefore shows that the fungal genes do not fall inside one clade together with all of these native genes, not by itself that they are of non-fungal origin. No control with the native set alone was run for this family.

tested_topology_constraint: fungal sus-like + the native fungal OCD-fold homologs + the 5 fungal OCD-fold proteins of the outgroup (11 fungal sequences) forced monophyletic
biological_alternative: As SUS_nat-3, with all fungal OCD-fold proteins of the tree.
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: the 58 leaves of SUS_nat-3 + the 5 fungal OCD-fold outgroup proteins = 63 leaves.
interpretation: Rejected: all fungal OCD-fold proteins of the tree do not form one clade; evidence against a single fungal ancestry of this set.
caveat: The native fungal set forced into the clade is not itself monophyletic in the unconstrained ML tree (also not after the fungal genes under test are pruned from it); a rejection therefore shows that the fungal genes do not fall inside one clade together with all of these native genes, not by itself that they are of non-fungal origin. constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 6 fungal pKerr14a-type acs-like genes + 27 T-DNA acs references (8 seed references and 19 other plasmid references). Other leaves free.

caveat: Negative result for the T-DNA acs relationship; the genes are placed with the pKerr14a-type acs-like references instead (ACS-2).

family: opine dehydrogenase, nos subfamily (Boletales genes; Rhypophila homolog, not assigned to any lineage)
tested_topology_constraint: Boletales nos-subfamily genes + native fungal opine dehydrogenases (19 sequences) forced monophyletic (native origin of the Boletales genes)
biological_alternative: The Boletales nos-subfamily genes are native fungal opine dehydrogenases (vertical inheritance).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 6 Boletales nos-subfamily genes + 19 native fungal opine dehydrogenases = 25 leaves.
interpretation: Rejected: the Boletales genes and the native fungal ODH do not form one clade.
caveat: The native fungal set forced into the clade is not itself monophyletic in the unconstrained ML tree (also not after the fungal genes under test are pruned from it); a rejection therefore shows that the fungal genes do not fall inside one clade together with all of these native genes, not by itself that they are of non-fungal origin. No control with the native set alone was run for this family (compare ODH-3).

tested_topology_constraint: odh-island ODH + all native fungal ODH forced monophyletic
biological_alternative: The odh-island genes of F. poae / F. langsethiae are native fungal opine dehydrogenases (vertical inheritance).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 3 island genes (F. poae Fp133, F. poae DAOMC252244, F. langsethiae MFG217702) + 9 native fungal ODH = 12 leaves.
interpretation: Rejected (p = 3.5e-06, deltaL 305).
caveat: The native fungal set forced into the clade is not itself monophyletic in the unconstrained ML tree (also not after the fungal genes under test are pruned from it); a rejection therefore shows that the fungal genes do not fall inside one clade together with all of these native genes, not by itself that they are of non-fungal origin. The control ODH-3 (the 9 native ODH alone forced into one clade) is itself rejected (p = 0.0064, deltaL 36.5); only the difference in deltaL (about 269) is attributable to adding the island genes.

tested_topology_constraint: odh-island ODH + native Sordariomycetes ODH (Apiospora, Astrocystis) forced monophyletic (vertical-inheritance expectation)
biological_alternative: The island genes belong with their closest native relatives (Sordariomycetes ODH; vertical-inheritance expectation).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: 3 island genes + 2 native Sordariomycetes ODH (Apiospora, Astrocystis) = 5 leaves.
interpretation: Rejected (p = 0.0004, deltaL 467): island genes are not sister to the closest native Sordariomycetes ODH.
caveat: The two native Sordariomycetes ODH are not monophyletic in the ML tree, so part of the penalty comes from forcing them together (see ODH-3).

tested_topology_constraint: control: native fungal ODH forced monophyletic (odh-island ODH unconstrained)
biological_alternative: Control: the native fungal ODH form one clade (island genes free).
constraint_definition: Forced into one clade: the 9 native fungal ODH only = 9 leaves; island genes and all others free.
interpretation: Rejected (p = 0.0064, deltaL 36.5): the native fungal ODH of this tree are not one clade.
caveat: Shows that the native set is itself not monophyletic in the ML tree; hence a rejected 'island + native' constraint cannot by itself prove HGT. Applies to ODH-1 and ODH-2, to NOS_nat-4/5, NOS_rh-7/8, ACS-4, ACS_nat-7, SUS_nat-3/4.
